subject: PO activation staging, invoice lane policy and early remit proposal
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@corelia.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@corelia.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding + PO cadence question (Corelia)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the intro last week. We are ready to finish vendor setup for Corelia with Redwood so we can get POs flowing in June. A couple of items on our side:

- Our AP team requires a 45-day net term by default; however, we can agree to Net 30 if there is an early-remit discount.
- We use a separate invoice lane for vendor onboarding that requires the PO number to be present on the first invoice. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred PO activation window and the invoice cutoff rules?

Attached: vendor_remit_contacts.csv (see note below).

Goal: finalize the onboarding packet and agree on whether an early-pay option (1.5% for Net 30) is acceptable to Redwood. Let me know what documentation you need (W9, supplier form, bank remit).

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Corelia Systems

[Attachment: vendor_remit_contacts.csv (csv)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@corelia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding + PO cadence question (Corelia)

Hi Sanjay — great to hear from you. Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front, then next steps: 

- PO activation window: We require the first PO to be created at the time of vendor activation or within the first 30 days after activation to avoid queueing delays for invoice routing.
- Invoice cutoff rules: invoices received without a PO will be held in the onboarding lane for review; to avoid delays please include PO# on the first invoice.
- Early-pay: we can evaluate an early remit for Net 30 at a 1.25% discount, subject to finance approval and a short pilot (2 invoices).

Next steps I propose:
1) I will send our Supplier Onboarding Form and the PO schedule template (attached). Please complete and return the onboarding form and bank remit details.
2) Marissa will run the early-pay economics with Finance and confirm whether the 1.25% rate is firm or whether we need to adjust.
3) If you accept the early-pay pilot, Ben will provision a separate invoice lane in AP to ensure prioritized routing.

I've attached: Redwood_SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING_FORM.pdf and Proposed_PO_Schedule.xlsx. If those look good, please return the completed PDF and a sample invoice with the PO field populated.

Hannah
Director, Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachments: Redwood_SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING_FORM.pdf (pdf), Proposed_PO_Schedule.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Supplier onboarding + PO cadence question (Corelia)

Hannah / Marissa — quick internal note on implementation:

- We can open an "onboarding" AP lane (priority flag) tied to the vendor record. That lane will auto-route invoices with PO# 1-3 as part of the activation check. After the pilot, normal routing resumes.
- For early-pay, finance historically approves 1.0% for Net 30 as a standard; 1.25% requires VP sign-off but is usually OK for strategic suppliers. For a pilot (2 invoices) I'd recommend we offer 1.25% contingent on no disputes and 14-day pay turnaround once invoices hit the queue.
- I'll prepare the invoice-lane config and the brief SOP for AP to ensure PO presence is validated automatically.

Action items: Ben to create the onboarding lane and SOP draft (ETA: EOD today). Marissa to confirm discount approval with Finance (ETA: EOD today). Hannah to confirm wording to Corelia.

Ben
AP Systems Manager
ben_carter@redwood.com

[No attachments]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@corelia.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding + PO cadence question (Corelia)

Hi Sanjay — looping back with confirmation from our side.

Thanks for providing the initial details. We reviewed the ask with Finance and can confirm the following proposal:

1) Onboarding & PO activation
- Redwood will activate Corelia's vendor record upon receipt of: completed Redwood_SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING_FORM.pdf, W-9 (or local equivalent), and bank remit confirmation.
- Please ensure the first PO number appears on the first invoice. Redwood will place onboarding invoices in the "Vendor Onboarding" lane until PO validation completes (typically 2 business days).

2) Early-remit pilot
- Offer: 1.25% discount for Net 30 invoices during a 2-invoice pilot.
- Payment SLA for pilot: Redwood will pay within 14 calendar days of invoice acceptance (no disputes).
- After pilot: Finance will review actual cycle times and decide on whether to formalize Net 30 + 1.25% for future work or revert to Net 45 standard terms.

3) Logistics & attachments
- Please complete and return the onboarding form and upload it to the link below. Also return a sample invoice showing the PO field so our AP lane validation can be tested.
- DocuSign envelope for supplier agreement: https://docusign.com/envelope/example12345

Attachments included with this email for your reference: Redwood_SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING_FORM.pdf, Proposed_PO_Schedule.xlsx, EarlyRemit_Terms.docx

If that aligns with Corelia, reply with the completed attachments and we will kick off activation the same day.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
